# Djinni.co

> > Eastern Europe's largest tech job marketplace connecting companies like Readdle, WIX, and PandaDoc with 60,000+ developers through direct hiring with no middlemen.

Djinni operates on a unique pay-per-hire success fee model (20-50%) with no subscription costs, featuring salary transparency and direct chat between employers and candidates. Founded by Nikita Kraev, the platform serves Ukraine, Romania, and Eastern European tech markets with a 46% response rate and 2-3 week average hiring time.

## Key Topics

- success-fee pricing model
- direct hiring (no middlemen)
- remote jobs
- anonymous job search
- salary transparency
- passive candidates
- tech recruitment
- manual QA testing
- Ukraine tech market
- Eastern Europe talent
- pay-per-hire
- no subscription
- Readdle
- 60K+ candidate pool
